purpose: Correct the active B17 presentation so the finite-window boundary guide obeys the researcher-supplied p<->1-p symmetry at p=0.5 and the plot shows the full fundamental p domain without inventing unsampled cells.
epistemic_role: Existing-data presentation correction; the dashed line remains a visual guide and the finite-grid region remains non-joint directional evidence.

symmetry_contract.statement: q_c(p)=q_c(1-p) after the deterministic syndrome/logical relabeling associated with complementing the physical-error configuration.
symmetry_contract.endpoint_obligation: On the plotted fundamental domain 0<=p<=0.5, the guide must satisfy dq_c/dp=0 at p=0.5.
symmetry_contract.implementation: Use a single parametric cubic Bezier with q_2=q_3=q_c and p_2<p_3=0.5, making the endpoint derivative exactly zero rather than numerically penalized.
symmetry_contract.claim_boundary: This is a project physical-model constraint supplied by the researcher; B18 does not use it to fabricate new cellwise evidence or a confidence interval.

guide.endpoints: Retain the B17 data-derived q=0 intercept and p=0.49-derived high-q intercept rendered at p=0.5.
guide.objective: Least-squares p displacement from the same B17 finite-grid bracket midpoints, evaluated by monotone inversion of q(u).

display.unsampled_display_rule: Leave the portion outside the measured p-cell edges blank; do not extrapolate the p=0.08 evidence to p=0 or claim a p=0.5 measurement.

required: analytic and sampled endpoint dq/dp equal zero at p=0.5
guide remains nondecreasing in both p and q and has no low-q reversal
B17 transition region and its nineteen brackets are unchanged
axis limits are exactly p in [0,0.5] and q in [0,1]
no unmeasured evidence cell is added
figure contains no curve legend or fitting-method footer
zero new decoder runs and zero new decodes

stop_rule: Stop after one existing-data symmetry correction, report promotion, regression run, and visual audit.

withdrawal.reason: No general p↔1−p observation equivalence for incomplete binary heralds; half-domain and horizontal-tangent constraints are invalid. Numerical payload retained only for historical provenance.
